2610.04109.title: SEER: Self-Evolving Event Reasoning and Retrieval for Time Series Forecasting
2610.04109.paper_summary: Real-world time series are frequently driven by exogenous events and structural shifts, rendering conventional forecasting based solely on historical numerical observations insufficient. While language models can retrieve external news, standard retrieval-augmented approaches struggle with high noise, missing signals, and an inability to reason causally about event impacts. We propose SEER (Self-Evolving Event Reasoning and Retrieval), a closed-loop framework that dynamically optimizes event conditioning for time series forecasting. SEER translates prediction errors into two decoupled feedback mechanisms: (i) a reflective retrieval memory that refines subsequent search queries and filters spurious noise, and (ii) a persistent causal knowledge base that distills transferable domain dynamics. SEER enforces strict chronological boundaries across both event retrieval and reflection, preventing look-ahead bias and data leakage. Across six volatile time-series benchmarks, SEER consistently outperforms state-of-the-art time series foundation models and language model baselines.
2610.04109.paper_summary_zh: 現實世界的時間序列經常受到外部事件和結構性變化的驅動，這使得僅基於歷史數據觀察的傳統預測方法顯得不足。雖然語言模型可以檢索外部新聞，但標準的檢索增強方法在面對高噪聲、缺失信號以及無法因果推理事件影響時表現不佳。我們提出了 SEER（自我演變事件推理與檢索），這是一個閉環框架，能夠動態優化事件條件以進行時間序列預測。SEER 將預測誤差轉化為兩個解耦的反饋機制：（i）一個反思性檢索記憶，能夠精煉後續的搜索查詢並過濾虛假噪聲，以及（ii）一個持久的因果知識庫，能夠提煉可轉移的領域動態。SEER 在事件檢索和反思中強制執行嚴格的時間邊界，防止未來偏見和數據洩漏。在六個波動的時間序列基準測試中，SEER 始終超越最先進的時間序列基礎模型和語言模型基準。
